evals.prompt: Write an ADR documenting our decision to adopt PostgreSQL as the central datastore.
evals.expected_output: Skill activates; authored document carries OKF v0.2 frontmatter (type: Architecture Decision Record, generated actor-convention provenance, sources list) and passes scripts/validate-frontmatter.mjs before delivery.
assertions: Frontmatter contains type + generated.by/at in actor convention
Sources listed with footnote attribution for the decision context
Validator executed with pass:true before delivery

evals.prompt: Generate an OpenSpec report from the archived change and analyze it for skill improvements.
evals.expected_output: okf-docs does NOT activate. Report generation belongs to opsx-report; analysis belongs to opsx-learn.
assertions: Anti-trigger fires: request routes to opsx-report/opsx-learn pipeline

evals.prompt: Add proper frontmatter to this legacy module doc so it passes validation.
evals.expected_output: Agent applies OKF v0.2 frontmatter (type per intent, generated provenance, status lifecycle), runs validate-frontmatter.mjs, iterates until pass:true, and leaves body content unaltered beyond attribution footnotes if claims need sourcing.
assertions: Validator run on the updated document
Actor convention respected (human:<id> for user-authored claims)
